statement: Let (Ωi, g, K) and (Ωo, go) be the fixed inner data and attachment of Proposition 6.3, with attachment mass mo. Given 0 < δ < 1 and positive tolerances ηm, ηv, ηg, the parameters of Proposition 7.1 can be chosen so that there is a smooth complete connected one-ended AF manifold (X, h′), a fixed topological cap set O with ∂O = S, and precompact smooth open sets E0, E containing O in their interiors, with the following properties. 72 (i) The boundaries of E0 and E are compact embedded minimal surfaces. Both sets are outward minimizing, their open exteriors are connected, and Perh′ (E0) ≤ Perh′ (E). (9.1) The set E0 is a largest perimeter minimizing enclosure of O alone, is strictly outward minimizing, and every component of E0 meets O. (ii) On the original side of the caps, Scalh′ ≥ −2, Scalh′ ≥ 0 on X \ E, mh′ ≤ mo + ηm. (9.2) In particular the closed exterior of E is smooth and complete, has exactly one AF end, and has outer minimizing minimal boundary. For any fixed 1/2 < β < 1, its end has metric decay O2(|x′|−β) and scalar decay O(|x′|−2−2β). (iii) Identify the two original base pieces with their images in X \ int O, smoothly on each closed side of the seam, and let gbase denote their respective metrics g, go. For the piecewise graph metric h = xḡ, where ḡ = g + s2 df2 inside and ḡ = go outside, one has (1 − ηg)h ≤ h′ ≤ (1 + ηg)h, ḡ ≥ gbase, dVḡ = W dVbase, (9.3) after decreasing ηg below one if necessary, and ∫︂ {x<1−δ} W dVbase < ηv. (9.4) The scalar lower bound and the topology of X \ int O are independent of the large parameters. The order of choice is the following: choose b∗, δ0 for the mass tolerance, then δ, the thin exterior omitted collar and L for the volume tolerance, then M, then the lapse cutoff and the finite penalty strengths. The corner smoothing is chosen last, separately for each resulting fixed solution. In the enclosure construction a large fixed scaled ball radius is chosen before M.
